recipes.name: Spicy Thai Basil Pork Stir-fry (Pad Kra Pao Style)
steps: Heat cooking oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and chopped red chilies. Stir-fry until fragrant (about 30 seconds).
Add ground pork and break it apart. Cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Drain any excess fat if desired.
Stir in soy sauce, fish sauce, salt (if using), and sugar (if using). Cook for 1 minute, ensuring pork is well coated.
Remove from heat and stir in Thai basil leaves until just wilted.
Serve hot, optionally with rice and a fried egg (not included in calorie count).

recipes.name: Lean Pork & Basil Lettuce Wraps with Chili Kick
ingredients: 1 cup Thai Basil leaves, roughly chopped
Large lettuce leaves (e.g., butter lettuce, iceberg) for serving
steps: Heat cooking oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and chopped red chili. Sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add ground pork, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until thoroughly browned and all liquid has evaporated, about 8-10 minutes.
Drain any excess fat. Stir in fish sauce and soy sauce, cooking for another 2 minutes until absorbed.
Remove from heat and stir in the chopped Thai basil leaves.
Taste and add salt if needed. Let the mixture cool slightly.
To serve, spoon the pork mixture into individual lettuce leaves and wrap them up.

recipes.name: Chili Basil Pork & Scrambled Egg Stir-fry
ingredients: Pinch of salt and pepper for egg
steps: Whisk the egg with a pinch of salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Heat 1/2 tbsp cooking oil in a pan over medium heat. Pour in the whisked egg and scramble until just set but still moist. Remove from pan and set aside.
Add the remaining 1/2 tbsp cooking oil to the same pan. Add minced garlic and chopped red chili; stir-fry until fragrant (about 30 seconds).
Add ground pork and cook, breaking it apart, until browned and cooked through (about 5-7 minutes).
Stir in soy sauce and fish sauce. Cook for 1 minute.
Return the scrambled egg to the pan. Add Thai basil leaves and stir everything together gently until basil is just wilted.
Serve immediately.
